candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Delay account sign-in until after the user picks and customizes their desktop pet. Users complete adoption selection first, increasing investment before authentication.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently has a 72.9% conversion rate with a 567s mean duration early in the flow. Shifting sign-in after pet adoption builds emotional attachment first.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync progress across all your desktop devices.
sign_in.hint: Using the same account restores existing pets without losing data.

guard.reason: Creates urgency by telling users to sign in now to lock in their pet choice.

candidates.title: Interactive Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive onboarding screen right before final completion that teaches users how to summon, move, hide, and talk to their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received multiple confusion reports from users unsure how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing setup.

new_controls_tutorial.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion
new_controls_tutorial.body: Click and drag to move your pet, right-click to open actions, or double-click to start chatting.

components.text: Drag to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk

candidates.title: Split Screen Live Pet Preview
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout showing a live desktop preview of the pet on the left alongside selection controls on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s), while users report pets missing or looking wrong.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: See how your pet will look and move right on your screen before adopting.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection layout preserves its core job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (39.1%) and funnel + support both highlight UI preview/quality issues, but requires major layout changes.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Hatching Wait Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive pet hatching sequence with tip carousels and desktop permission readiness checks.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), leading to support tickets about pets failing to appear on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Preparing Its Desktop Home...
waiting.body: We are generating high-res animations and configuring screen overlays.

wait_status.text: Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to summon your pet instantly.

candidates.title: Account Sync & Pet Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add clear helper text below sign-in options explaining how logging in restores existing adoption certificates and saved pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to automatically restore your pet and stats.

guard.reason: Adding sign-in recovery hint is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses the largest support ticket volume (8 emails) with a low-cost copy/hint modification on sign_in.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Bar & Time Estimate
candidates.change: Display explicit progress percentages and estimated seconds remaining while the app prepares the pet on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step drop-off is high with a mean duration over 38 minutes due to long background rendering without feedback.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Please keep this window open while we finish rendering your pet.

guard.reason: Adding a real progress estimate to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses massive mean delay (38+ min) on home step by adding visual feedback for background processing.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidelines
candidates.change: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips on lighting and contrast directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted that custom pet creation fails or results look distorted due to improper photo uploads.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear Photo for Best Pet Results
upload_photos.body: Use a well-lit photo with a single subject facing forward for best 3D pet generation results.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry images, extreme angles, or crowded backgrounds.

guard.reason: Photo upload quality guidelines improve onboarding without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy/guideline fix on the highest drop-off step (adoption), supported by 3 user complaints.

candidates.title: Path Selection Starter Benefits Banner
candidates.change: Add a prominent bonus indicator showing instant access to starter accessories and default pets when selecting a quick path.
candidates.why: The choose_path screen loses nearly 24% of users with an average duration of 514s due to hesitation.

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome
candidates.change: Reframe home_intro screen with a spotlight layout featuring shortcut hints and an instant desktop summoning test button.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not show up on the desktop after finishing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is allowed.

candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alert when pet preparation finishes on the waiting screen so users know when their pet drops onto the desktop.
